case_name: Abhyuday Ratra And Others vs State Of U.T. Chandigarh And Another

facts_of_case: FIR No.107 dated 19.08.2019 under Sections 406, 498-A IPC registered at Women Police Station, Chandigarh; compromise arrived at between parties; petition for quashing of FIR and subsequent proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: When parties have entered into a settlement and it is clear that there are no chances of conviction, quashing the proceedings is not illegal.
legal_principles.held: Hon'ble the Apex Court in Gold Quest International Private Ltd. vs. State of Tamil Nadu and others, 2014(4) RCR (Criminal) 206 has held
